title_description: Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting and Management System (CFCFRMS)
key_guidelines_claims: Dial 1930 to report financial fraud within golden hours (first 2-3 hours). Coordinates immediate freezing of funds across beneficiary banks and wallets.

title_description: RBI Kehta Hai - Digital Security Guidelines
key_guidelines_claims: Never enter UPI PIN to receive money. UPI PIN is solely required for deducting funds. Keep daily transaction limits activated.

title_description: Advisory on Fake Police / ED / CBI Digital Arrest Schemes
key_guidelines_claims: Law enforcement agencies (Police, CBI, ED, Court) never place citizens under arrest via Skype or WhatsApp video calls or demand funds transfer for clearing charges.
Citizens can report suspected fraudulent SMS, WhatsApp, and calls regarding fake KYC, electricity disconnection, lottery, or impersonation.
If unauthorized electronic transaction occurs through no fault of customer and is notified within 3 working days, customer liability is zero under RBI circular.
Scanning a QR code is exclusively for paying money, never for receiving money. Do not approve unknown Collect Requests.

title_description: Vulnerability and Security Advisory on Fake Wedding & Bank APKs
key_guidelines_claims: Avoid downloading APK files from WhatsApp, Telegram or SMS links. They install screen readers and SMS forwarding trojans that steal OTPs.
Official bank SMS always comes from approved alphanumeric headers (e.g., VM-HDFCBK, AX-SBINB) and never from ordinary 10-digit mobile numbers (+91-9xxxxxxxxx).

title_description: CyberDost Advisory on Rating / Task Fraud
key_guidelines_claims: Scams promising high returns for YouTube video likes or Google reviews lure victims into fake crypto/trading groups and freeze initial deposits.

title_description: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction 2016
key_guidelines_claims: Banks never deactivate accounts within 24 hours without prior formal postal/registered notice. Banks do not conduct re-KYC over unverified web links or third-party apps.
